outline:
國合專題特論乃透過國際大師的講課，讓學生學習有機及高分子材料相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic and polymeric materials. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.
schedule:
1. General properties of organometallic complexes
2. Carbonyls, Phosphines, and Substitutio
3. Oxidative Addition and Reductive Elimination
4. Homogeneous Catalysis
5. Metal carbene chemistry
6. Paramagnetic and High Oxidation-State Complexes
materials:
1. R. H. Crabtree, The organometallic chemistry of the transition metals, Wiley, Hoboken, New Jersey, 6th edn., 2014.
2. J. F. Hartwig, Organotransition metal chemistry: from bonding to catalysis, University Science Books, Sausalito, California, 2010.
3. C. Elschenbroich, Organometallics, Wiley-VCH, Weinheim, 3rd edn., 2006.
consultation: Department of Molecular Science, 2F, on Tue am10:00-12:00
